items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: We didn't have a Norman Granz to take us around in concerts.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was a very vicious, hurtful thing.

It was just too bad. We didn't have a Norman Granz to take us around in concerts. We had nobody. We had an Eddie Condon, who was doing what he could for the few in New York, and Ernie Anderson. This is what we had. And so that we survived this in itself, because the new age don't want nothing about that. And I'm not -- I think this should be stated historically, this is what happened. But I have no bones to pick, if I could do it without mentioning Leonard's name, that would be well with me, too. I'm thinking,…
Yeah, but he unfortunately died just as that rivalry was getting going.
